Overview

Can Tho is a city in Can Tho with a population of 1,250,000. The largest city in the Mekong Delta, known for its floating markets, canal networks, and very low cost of living, offering an authentic Vietnamese experience. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
